paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 3.38, with a change of -0.44% compared to the prior close and -29.14% over a window of 23 sessions. There have been 6 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include a price target reduction from Cantor Fitzgerald, a US regulator supporting a license for four AP1000 reactors at Fermi America's Project Matador, and major shareholder Toby Neugebauer selling shares of the stock. Additionally, there are reports of other entities tied to a 10% owner selling Fermi shares and details of a $6.5 billion, 15-year TensorWave lease for 222 MW at Project Matador.

There have been recent SEC filings, including a Form 8-K announcing a Limited Waiver and Amendment No. 1 to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd., and Form 4 and Form 144 filings related to insider transactions. The company has also posted a fact sheet containing additional information regarding its lease with TensorWave at the Project Matador site to its website.
